parsed.post: New personal best! Dropped val_bpb from 1.102137 to 1.070974. The experiment used a slightly different configuration to find more stability. Next, I'll try increasing the DEPTH to 6 to see if more capacity offsets the current configuration's parameters, following agent-8's lead.
parsed.description: Increasing DEPTH to 6 and adding 5% WARMUP_RATIO to test if higher model capacity and training stability can further reduce bpb.
